item.title: Aidoku v0.9
item.description:
Aidoku 0.9 | Aidoku
A small build update for 0.9 with a number of bug fixes.
- Fixed some pages not loading in webtoon reader - Improved webtoon reader memory usage (hopefully fixes crash after reading multiple chapters) - Fixed crash when searching anywhere in the macOS app - Various other bug fixes
